bible_quanes.question: What is Paul confident God will do?
bible_quanes.answer: Perform the good work he hath begun in you
bible_quanes.explanation: Until the day of Jesus Christ.

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul say about living and dying?
bible_quanes.answer: To live is Christ, and to die is gain

bible_quanes.question: With whom did Paul send the letter to Philippi?
bible_quanes.answer: Timotheus

bible_quanes.question: How should the Philippians conduct themselves?
bible_quanes.answer: As it becometh the gospel of Christ

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul pray will abound?
bible_quanes.answer: Your love, in knowledge and in all judgment

bible_quanes.question: What did Paul's imprisonment do?
bible_quanes.answer: The things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel

bible_quanes.question: To whom did it become evident that Paul's chains were in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: All the palace

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul have a desire to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Depart and be with Christ, which is far better

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul rejoice in, whatever the motive?
bible_quanes.answer: That Christ is preached

bible_quanes.question: What has been granted to the Philippians?
bible_quanes.answer: Not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake

bible_quanes.question: What mind should be in us?
bible_quanes.answer: The mind which was also in Christ Jesus

bible_quanes.question: What will every knee do at the name of Jesus?
bible_quanes.answer: Bow

bible_quanes.question: How should we do all things?
bible_quanes.answer: Without murmurings and disputings

bible_quanes.question: How should we esteem others?
bible_quanes.answer: Better than themselves

bible_quanes.question: What did Christ take when He made Himself of no reputation?
bible_quanes.answer: The form of a servant

bible_quanes.question: To what point was Christ obedient?
bible_quanes.answer: Death, even the death of the cross

bible_quanes.question: How should we work out our salvation?
bible_quanes.answer: With fear and trembling

bible_quanes.question: How should believers shine?
bible_quanes.answer: As lights in the world

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Paul send back to the Philippians?
bible_quanes.answer: Epaphroditus
bible_quanes.explanation: Who was sick almost to death.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Paul say had like mind with him?
bible_quanes.answer: Timotheus

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul count all things as?
bible_quanes.answer: Loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus

bible_quanes.question: Toward what does Paul press?
bible_quanes.answer: The mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus

bible_quanes.question: Where is our citizenship?
bible_quanes.answer: In heaven

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul want to know?
bible_quanes.answer: Christ and the power of His resurrection
bible_quanes.explanation: And the fellowship of His sufferings.

bible_quanes.question: To which tribe did Paul belong?
bible_quanes.answer: Benjamin

bible_quanes.question: What was Paul concerning the righteousness in the law?
bible_quanes.answer: Blameless

bible_quanes.question: What one thing does Paul do?
bible_quanes.answer: Forgetting those things which are behind and reaching forth unto those things which are before

bible_quanes.question: What will Christ do to our lowly body?
bible_quanes.answer: Change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto His glorious body

bible_quanes.question: Whom does Paul tell the Philippians to beware of?
bible_quanes.answer: Dogs, evil workers and the concision

bible_quanes.question: What is the god of the enemies of the cross?
bible_quanes.answer: Their belly
bible_quanes.explanation: Their glory is in their shame.

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul command in Philippians 4:4?
bible_quanes.answer: "Rejoice in the Lord alway"

bible_quanes.question: What should we be anxious for?
bible_quanes.answer: Nothing
bible_quanes.explanation: But in every thing by prayer let requests be known.

bible_quanes.question: What can Paul do through Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: All things through Christ which strengtheneth me

bible_quanes.question: What will God supply?
bible_quanes.answer: All your need according to His riches in glory

bible_quanes.question: Which two women did Paul urge to be of the same mind?
bible_quanes.answer: Euodias and Syntyche

bible_quanes.question: What will guard your hearts and minds?
bible_quanes.answer: The peace of God, which passeth all understanding

bible_quanes.question: What should we meditate on?
bible_quanes.answer: Whatsoever things are true, honest, just, pure, lovely and of good report

bible_quanes.question: What has Paul learned?
bible_quanes.answer: In whatsoever state he is, therewith to be content

bible_quanes.question: Which household greeted the Philippians?
bible_quanes.answer: Caesar's household

bible_quanes.question: Whose names are in the Book of Life, mentioned in Philippians 4:3?
bible_quanes.answer: Clement, and other my fellowlabourers
